book.name: MARKUS
book.title: MARKUS Markus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yesus nu kusem wande ŋayoŋgam tuku sakina

Yesus nu mayok ka kusem wande suŋgo ta kusrewam bafuna le nuŋe dubiwanu taŋgo andeŋge nu sana: Tum Taŋgo, ai te. Kusem wande te tuku wande kame magenu ndo. Nane ndame magenumbi patike likinaig ŋgina le
nu ndek sana: Ne wande sugo ŋakmba kaŋgerkate te ŋgumneŋga ndame ŋakmba muŋgu sailka mine nda. Afuŋge sambriniŋguwaig le ŋakmba kutusewamŋgaig ŋgina.
Kilke tugu kugawam tuku pasa
Nane kumba ka Olif tabe mbol promba Yesus nu kusem wande tumail tumba minyok minna le Petrus Yakobus Yohanus Andreus naneŋge ndo promba Yesus kusnanaig:
Ne kusem wande ŋayoŋgamŋgat ŋga sasiŋgat ta ginu mara prowamŋgat. Sine ame agaŋ kaŋgermba ait ta buk patukate ŋga idusmba katesewamŋgig ŋginaig le
nu pasa tugu pilmba nane wam paguniŋgina: Tane riroŋ mayewap. Afu pro tane yabritiŋbekaig.
Nane afu ye tuku nyu tumba ye Kuateŋge madiyina taŋgo ŋga gudommba didikuwaig le ndenuŋgaig.
Tane kame sugo maskenŋge mayok kuwaig le pasa ismba ko taŋgine tugumŋge kame zigna ande ismba tane wamdus fulil ndakap. Wam kame ta siŋka prowe likamŋgaig ta kugawam tuku ait kile.

Kilke ande tiŋga kilke kise ndoŋ kame buwamŋgaik. Gabat ande nuŋe gageu kilmba gabat kise tuku gageu ndoŋ kame buwamŋgaig. Ma yimyam mbolŋge mumni guba prowe likamŋgaig. Piti kame ta pino kutu te-palmbim tuku ŋgaro rar tate taŋaŋ prowamŋgaig.

Tane taŋgine riroŋ mayewap. Afuŋge tane kilmba pasa mbolŋge kile-tidiŋguwaig le afu naŋgine kusem wandekŋge tane pani faramŋgaig. Afu tane kilmba ka gabat sugo sugo nyu sugo ŋak mbal tugumŋge kile-tidiŋguwaig le tane ye tuku ŋga pasa mayenu saniŋgap le nane ye tuku nyu isamŋgaig.
Pasa mayenu kilke tugu ŋakmba mbolŋge kukliwap le ndo kugawam tuku ait prowamŋgat.

Nane taŋamba tane kilmba pasa mbolŋge patika mbal sugo wai mbolŋge patikuwaig le wamdus fulilka ndaŋmba sakube o ŋga wamdus te-sulu ndawap. Pasa te-tiwam tuku ait mbolŋge tane tuku wamdus sinamŋge pasa afu mayok kaŋgaig ta ndo sakap. Tukul Guwa nu wamdus tiŋguwa le pasa sakamŋgaig. Taŋgine wamdusmbi kuga.

Ait ta mbolŋge ande nuŋe tira nuŋe kasurmba kumam tuku ŋgueu mbal tuku wai mbolŋge palmbimŋgat. Taŋgo nu nuŋe kiŋo mbolŋge mata taŋawamŋgat. Kiŋo kame nane ina mam kat naŋgine kumwaig ŋga nane pasa mbolŋge patikamŋgaig.
Tane ye tuku taŋgo tukunu nane ŋakmba tane kasurtiŋgamŋgaig. Ande nu ye kusre ndayumba minmba ma ma kumwa ta Kuateŋge nu tuku muskil te-tiwe tambimŋgat.

Ŋgumneŋga ande nu ŋule parak tukul ma mbolŋge mayok ka tukul kuerka kutur tambimŋgat. (Tane pasa te burkade mbal tane wamdus pulutiŋguwa). Wam ta mayok kuwa le kaŋgermba kame suŋgo prote ŋga Yudea mbal nane kua ka tabe poŋguwaig.
Ande nu wande kawaŋŋge minmba kande nu pitik kua kumba wandekŋge agaŋ kilam idus ndawa.
Ande nu piro mbolŋge minmba kande luka nuŋe tawi tam idus ndawa.
Ait ta mbolŋge pino fuŋgulok pino kiŋo dabro amo nyanu ŋak ose. Nane piti suŋgo kaŋgeramŋgaig.
Tane Kuate yabaŋap le murke ait mbolŋge maŋau ta pro ndawa.

Ait ta mbolŋge piti suŋgo pasa ŋak prowamŋgat. Kuate nu agaŋ ndende ŋakmba kile-mayokkina ait mbolŋge ka kile ait te mbolŋge mata piti afu taŋaŋ kaŋger ndakeg. Ŋgumneŋga mata piti taŋaŋ ande prowe nda.
Kuate nu nuŋe kilam tuku madiniŋgina mbal idusniŋmba piti ait kuen ta kuerkina le ait fagnu ndo piti prowamŋgat. Nda kuerkina kande ait ta prowa le taŋgo ŋakmba ŋgisike sulude kande.
Ande nu tane satiŋmba kaŋgera Kristus Kuateŋge madina taŋgo minit te ko nu minit si ŋguwa kande nu tuku pasa ise ndakap.
Yabri taŋgo prowaig sulumba afu ye Kristus ŋgumba afu ye Kuate tuku tuan taŋgo ŋgamŋgaig. Nane Kuateŋge madiniŋgina mbal yabriniŋmba didikube ŋga nane wam kitek saŋgrinu ke likamŋgaig.
Tane mambilmba riroŋka minap. Wam kame ta prowamŋgaig. Ta tuku ye tane wam pagutiŋget.
Sina manzer ait suŋgo ta kugawa le ki mukumba dabunuŋgat. Tambun mata buluŋge nda.
Samba tuku saŋgri ŋakmba pirpurka buru-burukuwaig le mbai ŋakmba samba mbolŋge guroromba ndeke lika minamŋgaig.
Wam kame ta mayok kuwaig le ye Ndindo Katesek Taŋgo ye saŋgri suŋgo kilŋa ŋak gau sinamŋge prowi le nane ye kaŋgeryamŋgaig.
Ye ndeka eŋel kame kukulniŋgi le kilke tugu ŋakmba mbolŋge Kuate nuŋe madiniŋgina mbal kile-maŋgurkamŋgaig.
Tane fik ail kaŋgerap. Tane kuzrunu kitek promba nzude le kaŋgerka katesemba sakade: Ki ait patukate ŋgade.
Taŋamba ndo wam kame sakit te prowaig le kaŋgerka ye prowam tuku ait patukate ta kila palmbimŋgaig.
Ye siŋka satiŋgamŋgit. Ait te mbolŋge minig mbal kume ndakuwaig le wam kame ŋakmba ta prowamŋgaig.
Kilke tugu samba tugu ŋgisikamŋgaig. Ye tuku pasa ande ŋgisike nda. Minmba minamŋgat.
Ginu mara ki kanum ndaŋ ta ande nu kila mine ndakate. Samba mbolŋge eŋel mata nane gilai. Ye Kuate tuku Kiŋo ye mata gilai. Mam nu ndo kila minit.
Ait ta ginu mayok kaŋgat ta tane gilai tukunu tane riroŋka mambilmba minap.
Wam ta yaba pasa te suk. Taŋgo suŋgo ande ma ande kambim ŋga nuŋe piro mbal piro walmba ande wande kulatkam tuku pilmba sate: Ye mambilmba tairŋga mina ŋgate.
Wande miro taŋgo ginu mara prowamŋgat ta tane gilai. Furiram e ko furir ŋgamu e ko teg kaglinu ulwa le ko maratukuk ta tane gilai tukunu mambilmba tairŋga minap.
Tane idus ndamba minap le nu pitik ndo pro kaŋgerkikat.
Ye tane satiŋget pasa te taŋamba ndo nane ŋakmba saniŋget. Tane mambilmba minap ŋgina.
